verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents AI summaries with automatic labels and categorization of incoming mail, plus junk filtering so users can 'focus on the mail that matters.' That is a classification mechanism that could surface important items, but nothing shows it specifically identifies government or legal mail (IRS, state filings, service of process) or prioritizes it against deadlines. missing for 10: explicit flagging or labeling of government/legal/compliance mail, priority alerts or notifications for such items, deadline-aware handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
